case_title: State of Gujarat v. Kalusinh @ Harpalsinh
statutory_provisions: IPC s.302, s.34; Arms Act s.25(c); Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(x)
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302 r/w s.34 and sentenced to life imprisonment
high_court_outcome: Confirmed conviction of accused No.1, acquitted accused No.2
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleged that on 23.11.1997 at approximately 9.00 p.m., the accused were ploughing a disputed land, and the complainant party intervened and objected to their act. Thereafter, accused No.1 and 2 fired three gun shots which hit the deceased, wife of PW-5, and injured PW-6 and PW-7. The deceased died on the spot, while PW-6 and PW-7 were injured. The accused then fled the scene. An FIR was registered against all the accused under various sections of the IPC and the Arms Act. The trial court convicted accused No.1 and 2 under s.302 r/w s.34 and sentenced them to life imprisonment. The High Court affirmed the conviction of accused No.1 but acquitted accused No.2 due to doubts about his identification.
